source: Profiling should connect occupancy to scheduler behavior and resource throughput. If issue slots are frequently skipped because there are no eligible warps, more latency-hiding capacity may help. If the relevant compute or memory path is already near its sustainable limit, raising occupancy may do nothing.[3]
zh: 分析应将占用率与调度程序行为和资源吞吐量联系起来。如果由于没有合格的扭曲而经常跳过问题槽，则更多的延迟隐藏容量可能会有所帮助。如果相关的计算或内存路径已经接近其可持续极限，那么提高占用率可能没有任何作用。 [3]
